answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 215 Country: India Title: If i am praying Zohr and my Iman is praying Kasr Zohr then what we should do ( i am not in safr)? Question: If i am praying Zohr and my Iman is praying Kasr Zohr then what we should do ( i am not in safr)? Answer ID: 215 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 335=341/B) If the imam is musafir and he is leading the Zuhr prayer, then he will finish his salah by salam at two rakats . In this case you will not finish your salah by salam but will stand up and will complete the remaining two rakats without doing the qirat, as you are muqeem (not in journey) so you will offer complete four rakats . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
